notes.title: Abrez
notes.notes:
[p][b]Abrez[/b] is a fast-paced shooting game where you aim at colorful cans. Some cans increase your score, others reduce it. Shoot coins to buy special bullets: single, triple, or explosive. Each level lasts 3 minutes.[/p][p]A game where you shoot cans and try to beat everyone’s score. Reflexes, precision, and strategy are your best tools to climb the leaderboard.[/p][p]🎮 The [b]demo version[/b] is [b]available for free[/b] now.
📅 The [b]full release is coming soon[/b].
